scripts.build: npm run verify:assets && npm run verify:boundaries && tsc -b && vite build && npm run verify:dist
scripts.build:production: npm run verify:release && npm run verify:boundaries && tsc -b && vite build && npm run verify:dist
scripts.test:maintainer: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --isolated --frozen python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:assets && npm run verify:release-rights
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:maintainer && npm run build
